info.name: SoftData API - Current Routes
info.description:
Complete Postman collection generated from docs/openapi.yaml and the registered public commercial-bank asset route.

Setup:
1. Set baseUrl to the local server or hosted API URL.
2. Send the authentication requests first if you need protected account routes.
3. Copy the returned access token into accessToken.
4. API keys are optional for public routes; set apiKey only when you want to add X-API-Key manually.

All requests are GET unless the endpoint explicitly requires POST, PATCH, or DELETE. Never store production credentials in this collection.

item.name: Healthcare
item.description: Public Nigerian health-facility snapshot. The dataset contains 50,649 GRID3 Nigeria Health Facilities v2.0 observed records, last updated 2024-11-11. It is not a live NHFR register, a complete current operational facility list, or an FMoH licensing register. Results are always paginated with a default page size of 50 and a maximum of 100.

header.description: Optional. Enable this header when using an API key for higher limits and usage analytics.

request.description:
List source-verified health facilities with bounded pagination and optional filters. Search is a case-insensitive name substring match.

Method: GET
Path: /v1/healthcare/health-facilities

Query parameters:
- page: positive base-10 page number; default 1
- page_size: 1-100; default 50
- state_id: optional lowercase state ID
- lga_id: optional lowercase LGA ID
- facility_type: primary-health-centre, clinic, health-post, general-hospital, other, teaching-hospital, or specialist-hospital
- facility_level: primary, secondary, or tertiary
- ownership_type: federal, state, local-government, private, military, or other-public
- search: optional trimmed search text, maximum 100 characters

Expected responses: 200, 400, 500
